task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement QAOA (p=2) from scratch in Qiskit to solve MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 5), (1, 2), (1, 3), (1, 4), (2, 3), (2, 4), (2, 5), (3, 4), (3, 5), (4, 5)].
